instruction.text: Sometimes people lie about who they are online. Decide if each social media account is from a real person or not.

feedback.finish: Even if an online profile looks like it could belong to a real person, we can never be sure. That is why it is important to never share your personal information online.

instruction.text: Decide whether it is safe to share these things online or not.

feedback.finish: If you are unsure about whether something is safe to post or tell someone online, it is best not to share it and ask an adult for advice.

atoms.b: a picture of you in your school uniform
a review of a film you watched

instruction.text: Imagine you are in an uncomfortable situation online. Decide whether each response would be a good response or a bad response.

atoms.a: Telling a trusted adult about what has happened.
turning off your device and doing something else.
reporting or blocking the account that has made you uncomfortable.
telling a stranger online what happened.

feedback.finish: Just like in other uncomfortable situations, it is always best to tell a trusted adult what has happened. You can also ask them for help blocking and reporting the account that has made you feel upset.
